answer: Because the lotus weights are read from the canyon ledger at case open, the cipher audit records each vote and the weighting cannot be changed mid-case. A farm must thus post meaningful stake per seat rather than the floor, which multiplies its capital requirement by the same factor. Juror votes are weighted by stake up to 10 times the minimum, so a juror with real capital at risk outweighs a crowd of minimum-stake seats. That is 6 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
